The '''spread proton bomb''' was a cluster bomb-variant of the [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]], a large energy explosive device used in space combat and orbital bombardment.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During the Mission to Prefsbelt IV, Rogue Squadron procured several spread proton bombs while infiltrating the academy during the nighttime.
{{Endgame}}

*''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'' {{C|Co-op mode only}}
